claims.claim: tag `ep08` 的程式碼沒有把庫存加回去的寫法：沒有 `internal/service/expiry.go`，沒有 `internal/repository/expiry.go`；在 `db`、`internal`、`cmd` 的非測試檔裡，找不到 `stock +`、`IncreaseStock`、`restock` 這類字，也就是沒有加回庫存的 SQL 或函式。`expiry.go` 兩個檔與 `IncreaseStock` 是 tag `ep09` 新增的。
claims.claim_en: The code at tag `ep08` has no way of adding stock back: there is no `internal/service/expiry.go` and no `internal/repository/expiry.go`; in the non-test files under `db`, `internal` and `cmd` there is no `stock +`, `IncreaseStock` or `restock`, so no SQL or function adds stock back. The two `expiry.go` files and `IncreaseStock` are added at tag `ep09`.

claims.claim: 種子資料裡「27 吋螢幕」是商品編號 3，庫存 1 件。一張下單後沒有付款的訂單，已經從庫存扣掉那 1 件，螢幕庫存變 0；訂單的 `paid_at` 欄位只有付款時才會被寫入：非測試的 SQL 與 Go 程式裡，只有 `payments.sql` 的 `UPDATE` 寫 `paid_at`（`dbgen` 裡有它產生的同一句），下單用的 `InsertOrder` 只寫 `total_twd`。測試 `TestExpiry_UnpaidOrderIsReleasedAndStockComesBack` 的開頭先確認這個狀態。
claims.claim_en: In the seed data the 27-inch monitor is product 3 with a stock of 1. An order that was placed and never paid has already taken that 1 unit, so the monitor stock is 0; the order's `paid_at` is written only when a payment arrives: in the non-test SQL and Go code only the `UPDATE` in `payments.sql` writes `paid_at` (the generated `dbgen` file holds the same statement), and `InsertOrder`, which places an order, writes only `total_twd`. The test `TestExpiry_UnpaidOrderIsReleasedAndStockComesBack` first asserts this state.

checks.text: UPDATE products SET stock = CASE id WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE 10 END;
UPDATE orders SET paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, now()) WHERE id = $1 AND total_twd = $2;
INSERT INTO orders (total_twd) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id;

claims.claim: 遷移檔 `00006_add_order_expiry.sql` 為 `orders` 加上 `expired_at` 欄位，並建立索引 `orders_unpaid_idx`：索引只涵蓋 `paid_at` 與 `expired_at` 都是空的訂單，排序欄位是 `created_at`。
claims.claim_en: Migration `00006_add_order_expiry.sql` adds an `expired_at` column to `orders` and creates the index `orders_unpaid_idx`, which covers only orders whose `paid_at` and `expired_at` are both empty, ordered by `created_at`.

checks.text: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN expired_at timestamptz;
CREATE INDEX orders_unpaid_idx ON orders (created_at) WHERE paid_at IS NULL AND expired_at IS NULL;

claims.claim: 查詢 `ClaimExpiredOrder` 一次只取一張訂單：條件是 `paid_at` 為空、`expired_at` 為空、`created_at` 早於截止時間；依 `id` 排序，`LIMIT 1`，並且用 `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`，已被別的交易鎖住的訂單這一輪直接跳過，不等待。
claims.claim_en: The query `ClaimExpiredOrder` takes one order at a time: `paid_at` is empty, `expired_at` is empty, `created_at` is before the cutoff; ordered by `id`, `LIMIT 1`, with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, so an order locked by another transaction is skipped this round instead of waited for.

checks.pattern:
SELECT id FROM orders
WHERE paid_at IS NULL AND expired_at IS NULL AND created_at < \$1
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 1
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;

claims.claim: `Expiry.ReleaseOne` 在同一個交易裡依序做四件事：取出一張逾期訂單、讀它的品項、把每個品項的數量用 `IncreaseStock` 加回庫存、用 `MarkOrderExpired` 把 `expired_at` 設成現在，最後才 `Commit`。每次呼叫只處理一張訂單。
claims.claim_en: `Expiry.ReleaseOne` does four things in one transaction, in this order: claim one expired order, read its lines, add each line's quantity back with `IncreaseStock`, stamp `expired_at` with `MarkOrderExpired`, and only then `Commit`. Each call handles one order.

checks.pattern: (?s)e\.db\.Begin\(ctx\).*q\.ClaimExpiredOrder\(ctx,.*q\.ListOrderLines\(ctx, id\).*for _, l := range lines \{\n\t\tif err := q\.IncreaseStock\(.*q\.MarkOrderExpired\(ctx, id\).*tx\.Commit\(ctx\)

checks.text: UPDATE orders SET expired_at = now() WHERE id = $1;
UPDATE products SET stock = stock + $2 WHERE id = $1;

claims.claim: `ListOrderLines` 依 `product_id` 排序；結帳的 `Orders.Place` 在鎖商品之前，也先把品項依 `ProductID` 排序。兩邊鎖商品的順序一致。
claims.claim_en: `ListOrderLines` orders by `product_id`, and checkout (`Orders.Place`) also sorts its lines by `ProductID` before locking products. Both sides lock products in the same order.

checks.text: SELECT product_id, quantity FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY product_id;
sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool { return sorted[i].ProductID < sorted[j].ProductID })

claims.claim: `ExpiryJanitor.Run` 用 `time.NewTicker` 建立計時器，並 `defer ticker.Stop()`；每一圈先呼叫 `Sweep`，再用 `select` 等 `ctx.Done()` 或 `ticker.C`，`ctx` 被取消就 `return`。測試 `TestExpiryJanitor_RunStopsWhenContextIsCancelled` 證明 `cancel` 之後 `Run` 會回來。
claims.claim_en: `ExpiryJanitor.Run` creates a `time.NewTicker` and defers `ticker.Stop()`; each loop calls `Sweep` and then waits in a `select` for `ctx.Done()` or `ticker.C`, returning when `ctx` is cancelled. The test `TestExpiryJanitor_RunStopsWhenContextIsCancelled` proves `Run` returns after `cancel`.

claims.claim: `ExpiryConfig` 有四個欄位：`Interval`、`OrderTTL`、`RoundTimeout`、`Now`。預設值是每 1 分鐘掃一輪、訂單 15 分鐘沒付款算逾期、單輪期限 30 秒、時鐘是 `time.Now`。`Now` 是函式欄位，測試可以換掉。
claims.claim_en: `ExpiryConfig` has four fields: `Interval`, `OrderTTL`, `RoundTimeout`, `Now`. The defaults are one sweep per minute, 15 minutes unpaid before an order counts as expired, a 30-second budget per sweep, and `time.Now` as the clock. `Now` is a function field that tests can replace.

checks.text: Interval     time.Duration    // how often to sweep (default 1 min)
OrderTTL     time.Duration    // how long an order may stay unpaid (default 15 min)
RoundTimeout time.Duration    // the budget of one sweep (default 30 s)
Now          func() time.Time // the clock (default time.Now)

claims.claim: `Sweep` 每一輪用 `context.WithTimeout` 給自己一個期限（預設 30 秒），`defer cancel()`，並把這個帶期限的 `context` 傳給 `ReleaseOne`。錯誤分三種：錯誤是 `context.DeadlineExceeded` 而外層 `ctx` 沒被取消，記警告並結束這一輪；其他錯誤，外層 `ctx` 沒被取消時記錯誤並結束這一輪；找不到逾期訂單就結束這一輪。測試 `TestExpiryJanitor_SweepIsCancelledWhenTheRoundTimesOut` 把期限設成 20 毫秒，卡住的 store 在期限到時被取消，看到 `DeadlineExceeded`，`Sweep` 回傳 0。
claims.claim_en: Each round, `Sweep` gives itself a deadline with `context.WithTimeout` (30 seconds by default), defers `cancel()`, and passes that context to `ReleaseOne`. Errors fall into three cases: `context.DeadlineExceeded` while the outer `ctx` is still live logs a warning and ends the round; any other error logs an error if the outer `ctx` is still live and ends the round; no expired order left ends the round. The test `TestExpiryJanitor_SweepIsCancelledWhenTheRoundTimesOut` sets the budget to 20 milliseconds; the stuck store is cancelled when it runs out, sees `DeadlineExceeded`, and `Sweep` returns 0.

checks.text: j.logger.Warn("expiry sweep ran out of time, next round continues"

claims.claim: 逾期未付款的訂單會被釋放。測試下一張單買商品 1 的 2 件與最後 1 件螢幕，把時鐘撥快 1 小時後掃一輪：回傳釋放 1 張，商品 1 庫存回到 10，螢幕庫存回到 1，訂單的 `expired_at` 有值。再掃一輪釋放 0 張，商品 1 庫存仍是 10。測試 `TestExpiry_UnpaidOrderIsReleasedAndStockComesBack` 證明。
claims.claim_en: An expired unpaid order is released. The test places an order for 2 units of product 1 and the last monitor, moves the clock forward 1 hour and sweeps once: 1 order is released, product 1 is back to 10, the monitor is back to 1, and the order's `expired_at` is set. A second sweep releases 0 and product 1 stays at 10. The test `TestExpiry_UnpaidOrderIsReleasedAndStockComesBack` proves it.

claims.claim: 已付款的訂單不會被釋放：用 `Record` 記一筆付款後把時鐘撥快 1 小時，掃一輪釋放 0 張，商品 1 庫存維持 8。剛下單、還沒付款的訂單用真的時鐘掃，也釋放 0 張。測試 `TestExpiry_PaidOrderIsLeftAlone` 與 `TestExpiry_RecentUnpaidOrderIsLeftAlone` 證明。
claims.claim_en: A paid order is not released: after recording a payment with `Record` and moving the clock forward 1 hour, a sweep releases 0 and product 1 stays at 8. A just-placed unpaid order swept with the real clock also releases 0. The tests `TestExpiry_PaidOrderIsLeftAlone` and `TestExpiry_RecentUnpaidOrderIsLeftAlone` prove it.

claims.claim: `cmd/api/main.go` 用同一個 `workerCtx` 啟動兩個 goroutine：寄信的 outbox worker 與 `ExpiryJanitor`。收尾的 `defer` 先呼叫 `stopWorker()`，再等 `workerDone` 與 `janitorDone` 兩個 channel。`main.go` 另有一行編譯期檢查，確認 `repository.Expiry` 滿足 `service.ExpiryStore`。
claims.claim_en: `cmd/api/main.go` starts two goroutines on the same `workerCtx`: the outbox worker that sends mail and the `ExpiryJanitor`. The closing `defer` calls `stopWorker()` and then waits on both `workerDone` and `janitorDone`. `main.go` also holds a compile-time assertion that `repository.Expiry` satisfies `service.ExpiryStore`.

claims.claim: C# 的 `CancellationTokenSource` 可以建立在一段時間後自動取消的權杖，背景工作常寫成繼承 `BackgroundService` 的類別。Java 的 Spring 用 `@Scheduled` 註解排程。Go 的標準庫提供 `time.Ticker` 與 `context.WithTimeout`，由程式自己組合。
claims.claim_en: In C#, `CancellationTokenSource` can create a token that cancels itself after a delay, and background work is commonly a class derived from `BackgroundService`. In Java, Spring schedules work with the `@Scheduled` annotation. Go's standard library provides `time.Ticker` and `context.WithTimeout`, which the program combines itself.
